title: Picasso with Olga (not his first wife, the tour guide)
text: Olga was so knowledgeable on picasso’s works of art and the different periods of his art journey. She made all of the tour very fun with really fun information. I’m really glad she was my guide.
author: J6659HYannk

title: Highly encourage doing this tour
text: Olga was so knowledgeable about Picasso and kept things so interesting during our tour. Highly recommend.
author: Ann_K

title: Outstanding Tour of Picasso’s Works!
text: Olga E was a very experienced tour guide that introduced us to the full spectrum of Picasso’s works: from childhood to his later years and effortlessly examined the various painting periods of Picasso’s career. Outstanding.
author: Resort786014

title: Brilliant guide
text: Anna was a splendid guide - we learned so much from this tour
author: idunklettel

title: Picasso Museum Barcelona
text: Very thorough and detailed (maybe a bit long for average person) but glad I made it! She was excellent.
author: Ellen_M

title: The value of the tour...
text: The value of the tour depends on the guide. Our guide, Jordi, was superb - very friendly, knowledgeable, enthusiastic. As a result we thoroughly enjoyed the tour and left knowing much more about Pablo Picasso.
author: Grant_M

title: Animated and thoughtful
text: Olga E provided a wonderful, educational and informative tour.   She was animated and thoughtful.   We enjoyed the perspective she offered us.
author: 2Pippin2

title: Great tour with Olga E....
text: Great tour with Olga E. Picasso museum was great so the the tour would recommend. Audio was good. Fast paced.
author: Frank

title: This tour is worth it !
text: The tour was very good.  The guide was wonderful and provided much information.  He highlighted certain pieces of art created by Picasso as well as Picasso's father.  I really enjoyed learning about Picasso the painter, the man and the evolution of his work.   The tour was just the right length of time - 90 minutes.
author: Kathy_S

title: No history class needed
text: Jordi was very passionate about Picasso. My husband and I loved the tour. I learned more about Picasso from Jordi than my Art History class!
author: juanitan86
